series.definition: Etemad & Luciani, World Energy Production 1800–1985 (1991), machine-readable historical estimates distributed by The Shift Project. This file’s actual historical rows cover 1900–1979. Source energy unit Mtoe is retained exactly. No join to later EIA or Energy Institute series is performed.
limitations: Frozen publisher source bytes acquired 1 November 2026; this is not a live feed or a claim that all values are direct measurements.
Source units, quantities, source year labels and unavailable values are retained. No local interpolation, carry-forward, averaging, zero filling or numerical unit conversion is performed.

Countries and territories follow the publisher labels and country definitions. Historical borders or reporting populations may change even when a country name does not. Modern map geometry does not establish equivalent historical territory.
Production, consumption, trade, installed capacity and energy-accounting measures are separate. Native energy-content and physical units must not be added as independent quantities.
This is a historical reconstruction, not a modern meter-reading series. Source-country and imperial/colonial boundaries can differ from modern polygons.

Every repeated native source key is unavailable for mapping, including identical duplicates; all original source row numbers and values remain attached. No numerical sum, average or arbitrary row selection resolves those duplicates.
The source contains both historical Etemad & Luciani and later US EIA rows. This collection uses only rows explicitly attributed to Etemad & Luciani; the entire unmodified CSV remains downloadable.
This branch and its normalization are CC BY-SA 3.0 with attribution to Etemad & Luciani (1991), via The Shift Project, accessed 1 November 2026.
